response.rationale: Four T1/T2 sources (generation-effect meta, learning-by-teaching meta, concept-map meta, keyword mnemonic) and two T6 sources (knowledge integration, task involvement) link elaborative processing to better retention, though the evidence has caveats: Sagarra found rote pairs beat semantic mapping, and Ponce found learner highlighting helped memory but not comprehension, so the link depends on the type of elaboration.
